europe_now.title: Wildfires in France and Greece
europe_now.summary:
French firefighters have stopped the spread of the wildfires.
However, the fires continue to burn.

europe_now.title: Ceuta migrant crisis
europe_now.summary:
Around sixty thousand people crossed the border into Ceuta.
Fifty‑seven individuals died during the crossing.

top_stories.title: NATO missile detection near Poland
top_stories.summary:
NATO detected a Russian missile threat near Poland within six minutes.
Officials noted a delay in deciding whether to respond with force.

top_stories.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv
top_stories.summary:
Russian strikes on Kyiv resulted in nine fatalities.
Meanwhile, Ukrainian forces sank a Russian container ship.
